mainFields.name: FIELD NAME
mainFields.definition: FIELD DEFINITION

mainFields.name: CLIP
mainFields.definition: Unique identification number assigned to each property.

mainFields.name: CORELOGIC COUNTY CODE
mainFields.definition: A CoreLogic defined, persistent, 5-digit code that uniquely defines every county or county equivalent. In some cases, the CoreLogic County Code is based on FIPS code but may represent a prior version.

mainFields.name: APN (PARCEL NUMBER UNFORMATTED)
mainFields.definition: Assessor's Parcel Number in an unformatted form. This is most often used by the county and others as a unique key.

mainFields.name: APN SEQUENCE NUMBER
mainFields.definition: This internal sequence number is used to ensure uniqueness of the Assessor's Parcel Number.

mainFields.name: COMPOSITE PROPERTY LINKAGE KEY
mainFields.definition: Unique property key, which can be used to link to other files associated with property (used in Legacy Product).   This is a fixed-width field, with the APN component padded with blanks out to 45 characters within the composite key.

mainFields.name: FIPS COUNTY CODE
mainFields.definition: The current 5-digit Federal Information Processing Series codes used nationally that uniquely defines every county or county equivalent.

mainFields.name: ORIGINAL APN
mainFields.definition: Original Assessors Parcel Number (APN) in raw format provided on the assessor tax roll. Used if a county renumbers or changes their parcel IDs.

mainFields.name: TAX ACCOUNT NUMBER
mainFields.definition: The county or source number used primarily for billing. Note: this number is typically not unique to a parcel, but rather to a tax bill (multiple parcels can be combined on 1 bill).

mainFields.name: ONLINE FORMATTED PARCEL ID
mainFields.definition: APN that would link to CoreLogic online products.

mainFields.name: ALTERNATE PARCEL ID
mainFields.definition: An Alternate ID provided by some counties that can be used to identify a property.

mainFields.name: PREVIOUS PARCEL NUMBER
mainFields.definition: The prior parcel number if the county changed the number in the last year.  Otherwise, the field will be empty.  Always used in combination with PREVIOUS PARCEL SEQUENCE NUMBER.

mainFields.name: PREVIOUS PARCEL SEQUENCE NUMBER
mainFields.definition: Sequence number used in combination with PREVIOUS PARCEL NUMBER to make it unique.

mainFields.name: PREVIOUS PARCEL NUMBER FORMATTED
mainFields.definition: Most recent previous parcel number, segmented by dashes and periods.  Unlike PREVIOUS PARCEL NUMBER that is only populated in the year after the parcel ID change, this field will contain the Previous Parcel Number no matter how long ago the parcel change occurred.

mainFields.name: CENSUS ID
mainFields.definition: Comprised of Census Tract, Census Block Group, Census Block, and Census Block Suffix. These numbers are established by the US Department of Commerce (Bureau Of The Census).

mainFields.name: RANGE
mainFields.definition: The "range" portion of geographical coordinates based on local surveys. Ranges typically run east or west of pre-determined "meridian" in six mile intervals.

mainFields.name: TOWNSHIP
mainFields.definition: The "township" portion of geographical coordinates based on local surveys. Townships typically run north or south of pre-determined "meridian" in six mile intervals.

mainFields.name: SECTION
mainFields.definition: The "section" portion of geographical coordinates based on local surveys. Sections are 1 square mile and there are 36 sections within the intersection of a Range / Township.

mainFields.name: QUARTER SECTION
mainFields.definition: A section that has been divided into four "sub" sections (e.g., NE, NW, SE, SW).

mainFields.name: MUNICIPALITY NAME
mainFields.definition: Name of the Municipality where parcel is located.

mainFields.name: MUNICIPALITY CODE
mainFields.definition: Code supplied by the county or vendor that indicates the city, town or village in which the parcel is located.

mainFields.name: JURISDICTION COUNTY CODE
mainFields.definition: Some counties interchange or use this instead of municipality codes.

mainFields.name: TOWN CODE
mainFields.definition: Some counties interchange or use this instead of municipality codes.

mainFields.name: TAX RATE AREA CODE
mainFields.definition: County provided tax rate area code associated with the parcel.

mainFields.name: TAX DISTRICT COUNTY NAME
mainFields.definition: Name of the county provided tax district code associated with a parcel. Tax District County Name is delivered if available

mainFields.name: TAX DISTRICT MUNICIPALITY NAME
mainFields.definition: Identifies the municipality (city) tax district associated with a parcel. Tax District Municipality Name is delivered if available.

mainFields.name: SCHOOL DISTRICT NAME
mainFields.definition: Identifies the special school tax district where the property is located. School tax district name is delivered if available.

mainFields.name: FIRE DISTRICT COUNTY NAME
mainFields.definition: Describes the county-designated area where parcels share a common fire district and fire houses. Fire district name is delivered if available.

mainFields.name: WATER DISTRICT NAME
mainFields.definition: Identifies the water management authority assigned to the parcel. Water District Name is delivered if available.

mainFields.name: ELEMENTARY SCHOOL DISTRICT COUNTY DESCRIPTION
mainFields.definition: Elementary school district in which the property is located.

mainFields.name: HIGH SCHOOL DISTRICT COUNTY DESCRIPTION
mainFields.definition: High School or Secondary School District in which the property is located.

mainFields.name: NEIGHBORHOOD DESCRIPTION
mainFields.definition: County defined Neighborhood in which the property is located.

mainFields.name: SITUS CORE BASED STATISTICAL AREA (CBSA)
mainFields.definition: Core Based Statistical Area code as designated by U.S. Office of Management and Budget.

mainFields.name: CBSA TYPE
mainFields.definition: Type of CBSA identified, either Metropolitan or Micropolitan Area.

mainFields.name: LAND USE CODE
mainFields.definition: A CoreLogic established Land Use code converted from various county Land Use codes to aid in search and extract functions.

mainFields.name: COUNTY LAND USE DESCRIPTION
mainFields.definition: Current usage of property as defined by county level jurisdiction. Represents text description associated with County Land Use Code.

mainFields.name: STATE LAND USE DESCRIPTION
mainFields.definition: Current usage of property as defined by state level jurisdiction. Represents text description associated with State Land Use Code.

mainFields.name: MANUFACTURED HOME INDICATOR
mainFields.definition: This field is populated with a "Y" if a Manufactured Home is present on the parcel.

mainFields.name: ZONING CODE
mainFields.definition: The data contained in this field is based upon County and/or Local established Zoning Codes and is not converted by CoreLogic.

mainFields.name: ZONING CODE DESCRIPTION
mainFields.definition: County provided zoning code description that describes the allowable land use for the real property.

mainFields.name: PROPERTY INDICATOR CODE
mainFields.definition: A CoreLogic general code used to easily recognize specific property types (e.g., Single Family Residence, Condominium, Commercial).

mainFields.name: NUMBER OF BUILDINGS
mainFields.definition: Total number of buildings on the parcel.

mainFields.name: VIEW CODE
mainFields.definition: View from building (e.g., Gulf, Mountains, Pool).

mainFields.name: LOCATION INFLUENCE CODE
mainFields.definition: Positive or negative aspects associated with the location of the parcel (e.g., Waterfront, Flood Plain, Airport).

mainFields.name: FORECLOSURE STAGE CODE
mainFields.definition:
CoreLogic standardized code that indicates the foreclosure process stage.  
Values:
YA = Auction
YD = Pre-Foreclosure
RR = REO (Real Estate Owned)
SS = REO Sale

mainFields.name: LAST FORECLOSURE TRANSACTION DATE
mainFields.definition: CoreLogic derived date that identifies the parcel's chronology of active foreclosure transactions. Data is a concatenation of first eight characters of a date from the foreclosure filing date or foreclosure recording date fields.

mainFields.name: BLOCK LEVEL LATITUDE
mainFields.definition: CoreLogic derived geographic coordinate that specifies the north–south position of a point based on United States Postal Service address data for the parcel. The latitude contains numeric data values only conforming to the mask XX.ZZZZZZ, where the XX are the digits to the left of the decimal point, and ZZZZZZ are the digits to the right of the decimal point. Latitude is always a positive value north on the North American continent.

mainFields.name: BLOCK LEVEL LONGITUDE
mainFields.definition: CoreLogic derived geographic coordinate that specifies the east–west position of a point based on United States Postal Service address data for the parcel. The longitude contains numeric data values only conforming to the mask -XXX.ZZZZZZ, where the XXX are the numeric digits to the left of the decimal point, and ZZZZZZ are the 6 numeric digits to the right of the decimal point. Longitude is negative on the North American continent.

mainFields.name: PARCEL LEVEL LATITUDE
mainFields.definition: CoreLogic proprietary parcel-centroid coordinate that specifies the north–south position of the center point of a parcel. The latitude contains numeric data values only conforming to the mask XX.ZZZZZZ, where the XX are the digits to the left of the decimal point, and ZZZZZZ are the digits to the right of the decimal point. Latitude is always a positive value north on the North American continent.

mainFields.name: PARCEL LEVEL LONGITUDE
mainFields.definition: CoreLogic proprietary parcel-centroid coordinate that specifies the east–west position of the center point of a parcel. The longitude contains numeric data values only conforming to the mask -XXX.ZZZZZZ, where the XXX are the numeric digits to the left of the decimal point, and ZZZZZZ are the 6 numeric digits to the right of the decimal point. Longitude is negative on the North American continent.

mainFields.name: SITUS HOUSE NUMBER
mainFields.definition: The digits found to the left of a street name.

mainFields.name: SITUS HOUSE NUMBER SUFFIX
mainFields.definition: The characters found to the immediate right of a house number (e.g., 202B Jones Rd).

mainFields.name: SITUS HOUSE NUMBER 2
mainFields.definition: The second set of numbers in an address range.

mainFields.name: SITUS DIRECTION
mainFields.definition: This field represents the direction found to the left of the street name (e.g., 9340 N Dunhill Dr). AKA Directional Abbreviations, Pre-Directional.

mainFields.name: SITUS STREET NAME
mainFields.definition: The name or number of the street where a parcel is located.

mainFields.name: SITUS MODE
mainFields.definition: The Mode or Type of street found to the right of the street name (e.g., 9340 N Dunhill Dr). AKA Street Designators / Street Suffixes.

mainFields.name: SITUS QUADRANT
mainFields.definition: The quadrant is found to the right of Situs Mode (e.g., 2040 NW 100 ST SW). AKA Post-Directional.

mainFields.name: SITUS UNIT NUMBER
mainFields.definition: The unit or suite number of the property address (e.g., 649 Lake Shore Dr #1400).

mainFields.name: SITUS CITY
mainFields.definition: The city associated with the property address.

mainFields.name: SITUS STATE
mainFields.definition: The two-letter USPS postal abbreviation associated with the state / protectorates / commonwealth (e.g., CA, VI).

mainFields.name: SITUS ZIP CODE
mainFields.definition: Code assigned by the USPS. This is populated by various source files and other proprietary and non-proprietary processes. Data may be the 5-digit zip or 9-digit Zip+4 (e.g., 00501 or 954630042).

mainFields.name: SITUS COUNTY
mainFields.definition: Situs county name.

mainFields.name: SITUS CARRIER ROUTE
mainFields.definition: This is the four digit code used by the local mail carrier to identify the delivery path.

mainFields.name: SITUS STREET ADDRESS
mainFields.definition: Full Situs address (not including City/St/Zip) (e.g. 123 N Main St)

mainFields.name: SITUS CITY STATE ZIP SOURCE
mainFields.definition:
Indicates the source of the City, State, and Zip address from the county file   
Values:
M = Mailing
S = Situs

mainFields.name: SITUS DELIVERY POINT VALIDATION CODE
mainFields.definition: CoreLogic standardized code contains the USPS delivery point validation code used to obtain Coding Accuracy Support System (CASS) Certification.Y = Address was DPV confirmed for both primary and (if present) secondary numbers.D = Address was DPV confirmed for the primary number only, and Secondary number information was missing.S = Address was DPV confirmed for the primary number only, and Secondary number information was present but unconfirmed.N = Both Primary and (if present) Secondary number information failed to DPV Confirm.Blank = Address not presented to hash table.

mainFields.name: SITUS DELIVERY POINT VALIDATION VACANT INDICATOR
mainFields.definition:
CoreLogic standardized code contains the USPS delivery point validation indicator showing if the property is vacant or occupied. 
Values: 
0 = Populated 
1 = Vacant

mainFields.name: PROPERTY HOUSE NUMBER - ENRICHED
mainFields.definition: Full house number of the property (e.g., 2040 or 10-4562).

mainFields.name: PROPERTY STREET NAME PREFIX DIRECTION - ENRICHED
mainFields.definition: This field represents the direction found to the left of the street name (e.g., 9340 N Dunhill Dr). AKA Directional Abbreviations, Pre-Directional.

mainFields.name: PROPERTY STREET NAME - ENRICHED
mainFields.definition: The name or number of the street where a parcel is located.  Includes the full street name (e.g., VIA VAL VERDE).

mainFields.name: PROPERTY STREET NAME SUFFIX - ENRICHED
mainFields.definition: The Mode or Type of street found to the right of the street name (e.g., 9340 N Dunhill Dr). AKA Street Designators / Street Suffixes.

mainFields.name: PROPERTY STREET NAME SUFFIX DIRECTION - ENRICHED
mainFields.definition: The quadrant is found to the right of Situs Mode (e.g., 2040 NW 100 ST SW). AKA Post-Directional.

mainFields.name: PROPERTY UNIT TYPE - ENRICHED
mainFields.definition: The unit type of the property (e.g., Suite; Apt., #).

mainFields.name: PROPERTY UNIT NUMBER - ENRICHED
mainFields.definition: The unit or suite number of the property address (e.g., 649 Lake Shore Dr #1400).

mainFields.name: PROPERTY CITY - ENRICHED
mainFields.definition: The city associated with the property address.

mainFields.name: PROPERTY STATE - ENRICHED
mainFields.definition: The two-letter USPS postal abbreviation associated with the state / protectorates / commonwealth (e.g., CA, VI).

mainFields.name: PROPERTY ZIPCODE 5 - ENRICHED
mainFields.definition: Code assigned by the USPS. This is populated by various source files and other proprietary and non-proprietary processes. Data will be the 5-digit zip (e.g., 00501).

mainFields.name: PROPERTY ZIPCODE PLUS 4 - ENRICHED
mainFields.definition: This is the four-digit code used by the local mail carrier to identify the delivery path.

mainFields.name: PROPERTY COUNTY NAME - ENRICHED
mainFields.definition: Situs county name.

mainFields.name: PROPERTY ADDRESS LINE - ENRICHED
mainFields.definition: Full address line of the property (e.g., 123 N MAIN ST APT. 400)

mainFields.name: PROPERTY CITY LINE - ENRICHED
mainFields.definition: Full city line including city, state and zip code (e.g., EDMOND OK 73012-4174).

mainFields.name: PROPERTY FULL ADDRESS - ENRICHED
mainFields.definition: The full property address (e.g., 123 N MAIN ST EDMOND OK 73012).  May contain the full zip code 73012-4174).

mainFields.name: LEGAL BLOCK NUMBER
mainFields.definition: Identifies the county block number where the parcel is located. Part of a subdivision or tract legal description. Subdivisions are often broken down into blocks, which are then broken down into lots.

mainFields.name: LEGAL BLOCK NUMBER SUFFIX
mainFields.definition: Identifies the county block number suffix where the parcel is located.

mainFields.name: LEGAL LOT NUMBER
mainFields.definition: Subdivision or County Map Lot Number. Part of a subdivision or tract legal description. Subdivisions are often broken down into blocks, which are then broken down into lots.

mainFields.name: LEGAL LOT NUMBER SUFFIX
mainFields.definition: Subdivision or County Map Lot Number Suffix.

mainFields.name: SUBDIVISION TRACT NUMBER
mainFields.definition: The unique number assigned to a specific subdivision by the county. Often this is used in lieu of an actual subdivision name.

mainFields.name: SUBDIVISION PLAT BOOK
mainFields.definition: The first component of a recording system used by some counties to catalog subdivision / condo plans (e.g., Book 123 Page 55A).

mainFields.name: SUBDIVISION PLAT PAGE
mainFields.definition: The second component of a recording system used by some counties to catalog subdivision / condo plans (e.g., Book 123 Page 55A).

mainFields.name: SUBDIVISION NAME
mainFields.definition: The name of the Subdivision or Condominium where the parcel is located (e.g., Highland Mills Estates, Crystal Towers Condo).

mainFields.name: LEGAL DESCRIPTION
mainFields.definition: County or local jurisdiction legal property descriptions. This description provides additional information regarding the property. It primarily delineates the exact boundaries of the property and may include other values like mineral rights, description of the layout of the property, etc.

mainFields.name: OWNER 1 FULL NAME
mainFields.definition: Full name of property owner - 1st occurrence.

mainFields.name: OWNER 1 LAST NAME
mainFields.definition: Last name of property owner - 1st occurrence.

mainFields.name: OWNER 1 FIRST NAME AND MIDDLE INITIAL
mainFields.definition: First name and middle initial of property owner - 1st occurrence.

mainFields.name: OWNER 2 FULL NAME
mainFields.definition: Additional owner name if more than one entity owns the property.

mainFields.name: OWNER 2 LAST NAME
mainFields.definition: Additional owner name data if more than one entity owns the property.

mainFields.name: OWNER 2 FIRST NAME AND MIDDLE INITIAL
mainFields.definition: Additional owner name data if more than one entity owns the property.

mainFields.name: OWNER 1 CORPORATE INDICATOR
mainFields.definition: Indicator that the property owner has been recognized as a corporation or business.

mainFields.name: OWNER 2 CORPORATE INDICATOR
mainFields.definition: Indicator that the property owner has been recognized as a corporation or business.

mainFields.name: OWNER 3 FULL NAME
mainFields.definition: Additional owner name if more than one entity owns the property.

mainFields.name: OWNER 3 LAST NAME
mainFields.definition: Additional owner name data if more than one entity owns the property.

mainFields.name: OWNER 3 FIRST NAME AND MIDDLE INITIAL
mainFields.definition: Additional owner name data if more than one entity owns the property.

mainFields.name: OWNER 3 CORPORATE INDICATOR
mainFields.definition: Indicator that the property owner has been recognized as a corporation or business.

mainFields.name: OWNER 4 FULL NAME
mainFields.definition: Additional owner name if more than one entity owns the property.

mainFields.name: OWNER 4 LAST NAME
mainFields.definition: Additional owner name data if more than one entity owns the property.

mainFields.name: OWNER 4 FIRST NAME AND MIDDLE INITIAL
mainFields.definition: Additional owner name data if more than one entity owns the property.

mainFields.name: OWNER 4 CORPORATE INDICATOR
mainFields.definition: Indicator that the property owner has been recognized as a corporation or business.

mainFields.name: OWNER ETAL CODE
mainFields.definition:
A code appearing in this field indicates additional ownership, whose name(s) were not provided by our sources. Values are:
A = ET AL - AND OTHERS
C = ET CON - AND HUSBAND
U = ET UX - AND WIFE
V = ET VIR - AND HUSBAND.

mainFields.name: OWNER OWNERSHIP RIGHTS CODE
mainFields.definition: Form or method of property ownership (e.g., Joint Tenants, Living Trust).

mainFields.name: OWNER RELATIONSHIP TYPE CODE
mainFields.definition: Relationship between multiple owners or the marital status of a single owner (e.g., Husband/Wife, Unmarried Man).

mainFields.name: OWNER OCCUPANCY CODE
mainFields.definition: CoreLogic derived code that indicates if the property owner resides at the situs (property site). Values of M, O, and S indicate owner occupied (A and T reflect absentee owners).

mainFields.name: OWNER 1 ORIGINAL TRUST NAME
mainFields.definition: Owner 1 Original Trust Name found on the document which is the original provided source name.

mainFields.name: MAILING HOUSE NUMBER
mainFields.definition: The digits found to the left of a street name, representing the house number for the mailing address.

mainFields.name: MAILING HOUSE NUMBER SUFFIX
mainFields.definition: The characters found to the immediate right of a house number (e.g., 202B Jones Rd).

mainFields.name: MAILING HOUSE NUMBER 2
mainFields.definition: The second set of numbers in an address range.

mainFields.name: MAILING DIRECTION
mainFields.definition: This field represents the direction found to the left of the street name (e.g., 9340 N Dunhill Dr). AKA Directional Abbreviations, Pre-Directional.

mainFields.name: MAILING STREET NAME
mainFields.definition: The name or number of the street of the mailing address.

mainFields.name: MAILING MODE
mainFields.definition: The Mode or Type of street found to the right of the street name (e.g., 9340 N Dunhill Dr). AKA Street Designators / Street Suffixes.

mainFields.name: MAILING QUADRANT
mainFields.definition: The quadrant is found to the right of Mailing Mode (e.g., 2040 NW 100 ST SW). AKA Post-Directional.

mainFields.name: MAILING UNIT NUMBER
mainFields.definition: The unit or suite number of the mailing address (e.g., 649 Lake Shore Dr #1400).

mainFields.name: MAILING CITY
mainFields.definition: The city associated with the mailing address.

mainFields.name: MAILING STATE
mainFields.definition: The two-letter USPS postal abbreviation associated with the state / protectorates / commonwealth (e.g., CA, VI).

mainFields.name: MAILING ZIP CODE
mainFields.definition: Code assigned by the USPS. This is populated by various source files and other proprietary and non-proprietary processes. Data may be the 5-digit zip or 9-digit Zip+4 (e.g., 00501 or 954630042).

mainFields.name: MAILING CARRIER ROUTE
mainFields.definition: This is the four digit code used by the local mail carrier to identify the delivery path.

mainFields.name: MAILING STREET ADDRESS
mainFields.definition: Full mail address (not including City/St/Zip) (e.g. 123 N Main St).  This also contains unparsed foreign mailing address.

mainFields.name: OWNER CARE OF NAME
mainFields.definition: CoreLogic standardized and parsed name for the person receiving mail on behalf of the owner.

mainFields.name: MAILING OPT OUT INDICATOR
mainFields.definition: A "Y" represents a record where the property owner has contacted the DMA (i.e., Direct Marketing Association) and has asked not to be contacted by mail for solicitation.

mainFields.name: MAILING DELIVERY POINT VALIDATION CODE
mainFields.definition: CoreLogic standardized code contains the USPS delivery point validation code used to obtain Coding Accuracy Support System (CASS) Certification.  Y = Address was DPV confirmed for both primary and (if present) secondary numbers.D = Address was DPV confirmed for the primary number only, and Secondary number information was missing.S = Address was DPV confirmed for the primary number only, and Secondary number information was present but unconfirmed.N = Both Primary and (if present) Secondary number information failed to DPV Confirm.Blank = Address not presented to hash table.

mainFields.name: MAILING DELIVERY POINT VALIDATION VACANT INDICATOR
mainFields.definition:
CoreLogic internal field containing the United State Postal Service (USPS) delivery point validation that indicates a vacant property.
Values:
1 = Yes, exclude from data or products
0= No exclusion

mainFields.name: CALCULATED TOTAL VALUE
mainFields.definition: The "TOTAL" (i.e., Land + Improvement) Value closest to current market value used for assessment by county or local taxing authorities.

mainFields.name: CALCULATED LAND VALUE
mainFields.definition: The "LAND" Value closest to current market value used for assessment by county or local taxing authorities.

mainFields.name: CALCULATED IMPROVEMENT VALUE
mainFields.definition: The "IMPROVEMENT" Value closest to current market value used for assessment by county or local taxing authorities.

mainFields.name: CALCULATED TOTAL VALUE SOURCE CODE
mainFields.definition: The code appearing in this indicator field reflects the type of values used to seed the TOTAL VALUE CALCULATED field (i.e., A = Assessed, M = Market, P = Appraised, T = Transitional).

mainFields.name: ASSESSED TOTAL VALUE
mainFields.definition: The Total Assessed Value of the Parcel's Land & Improvement values as provided by the county or local taxing/assessment authority.

mainFields.name: ASSESSED LAND VALUE
mainFields.definition: The Assessed Land Value as provided by the county or local taxing/assessment authority.

mainFields.name: ASSESSED IMPROVEMENT VALUE
mainFields.definition: The Assessed Improvement Value as provided by the county or local taxing/assessment authority.

mainFields.name: MARKET TOTAL VALUE
mainFields.definition: The Total Market Value of the Parcel's Land & Improvement values as provided by the county or local taxing/assessment authority.

mainFields.name: MARKET LAND VALUE
mainFields.definition: The Market Land Value as provided by the county or local taxing/assessment authority.

mainFields.name: MARKET IMPROVEMENT VALUE
mainFields.definition: The Market Improvement Value as provided by the county or local taxing/assessment authority.

mainFields.name: APPRAISED TOTAL VALUE
mainFields.definition: The Total Appraised Value of the Parcel's Land & Improvement as provided by the county or local taxing/assessment authority.

mainFields.name: APPRAISED LAND VALUE
mainFields.definition: The Appraised Land Value as provided by the county or local taxing/assessment authority.

mainFields.name: APPRAISED IMPROVEMENT VALUE
mainFields.definition: The Appraised Improvement Value as provided by the county or local taxing/assessment authority.

mainFields.name: TOTAL TAX AMOUNT
mainFields.definition: Total property tax amount for the current tax year.

mainFields.name: NET TAX AMOUNT
mainFields.definition: Property tax amount less exemptions and/or credits.

mainFields.name: TAX YEAR
mainFields.definition: The tax year for which the taxes were billed.

mainFields.name: ASSESSED YEAR
mainFields.definition: The assessment year for which the taxes were billed.

mainFields.name: TAX AREA CODE
mainFields.definition: Identifies the tax area code associated with the parcel.

mainFields.name: TOTAL PROPERTY TAX RATE PERCENT
mainFields.definition: County provided tax rate for the property based on Property Taxes billed through the county.

mainFields.name: TAXABLE IMPROVEMENT VALUE
mainFields.definition: County provided value of the improvement applied to the parcel used in the calculation of the tax bill.

mainFields.name: TAXABLE LAND VALUE
mainFields.definition: County provided land value of a parcel used in the calculation of the tax bill.

mainFields.name: TAXABLE OTHER VALUE
mainFields.definition: County provided value of fixture, features or miscellaneous values used in the calculation of the tax bill.

mainFields.name: NET TAXABLE VALUE
mainFields.definition: Assessed Value less exemptions or credits.

mainFields.name: HOMESTEAD EXEMPT INDICATOR
mainFields.definition: This field will be set with a "Y" if the owner has qualified for a Homeowner/Homestead exemption.

mainFields.name: SENIOR EXEMPT INDICATOR
mainFields.definition: This field will be set with a "Y" if the owner has qualified for a Senior exemption.

mainFields.name: DISABLED EXEMPT INDICATOR
mainFields.definition: This field will be set with a "Y" if the owner has qualified for a Disabled exemption.

mainFields.name: VETERAN EXEMPT INDICATOR
mainFields.definition: This field will be set with a "Y" if the owner has qualified for a Veteran exemption.

mainFields.name: WIDOW EXEMPT INDICATOR
mainFields.definition: This field will be set with a "Y" if the owner has qualified for a Widow exemption.

mainFields.name: TOTAL TAX EXEMPTION AMOUNT
mainFields.definition: Total amount of assessed value exempt from taxation.

mainFields.name: CALCULATED TOTAL TAX EXEMPTION AMOUNT
mainFields.definition: CoreLogic calculated total amount of all the exemptions to property taxes on the property site.

mainFields.name: TRANSACTION BATCH DATE
mainFields.definition: CoreLogic internal date number - can be used in the creation of unique keys (format is YYYYMMDD).

mainFields.name: TRANSACTION BATCH SEQUENCE NUMBER
mainFields.definition: CoreLogic internal sequence number - can be used in the creation of unique keys.

mainFields.name: MULTI OR SPLIT PARCEL CODE
mainFields.definition: Indicates either that the transaction involves multiple parcels, or the split of an existing parcel.

mainFields.name: SALE RECORDED DOCUMENT NUMBER
mainFields.definition: The document number used by some counties to record sales transactions.

mainFields.name: SALE RECORDED DOCUMENT BOOK NUMBER
mainFields.definition: The Book number used by some counties to catalog their sales recordings.

mainFields.name: SALE RECORDED DOCUMENT PAGE NUMBER
mainFields.definition: The Page number used by some counties to catalog their sales recordings.

mainFields.name: SALE DOCUMENT TYPE CODE
mainFields.definition: The type of deed used to record the sales transaction (e.g., Grant, Quit, Foreclosure).

mainFields.name: SALE RECORDING DATE
mainFields.definition: The date the sales transaction was recorded at the county. This date is generally considered the transfer of ownership date. Format: YYYYMMDD.

mainFields.name: SALE DATE
mainFields.definition: Date that the deed was prepared in advance of being notarized and prior to being recorded. If the day and/or month is missing, CoreLogic populates these values with 00. Format: YYYYMMDD.

mainFields.name: SALE AMOUNT
mainFields.definition: Dollar amount of the most recent sale of the property.

mainFields.name: SALE TYPE CODE
mainFields.definition: This field indicates what the financial consideration is - if a Deed record represents a change of ownership (Sale).

mainFields.name: TRANSACTION TYPE CODE
mainFields.definition: This field details the type of real estate transaction associated with a single recorded legal document, or a set of concurrently recorded documents, i.e. Market Sale with or without a Mortgage, Standalone Mortgage, Construction Financing Loan, etc.

mainFields.name: TITLE COMPANY CODE
mainFields.definition: This is a CoreLogic internal code used to identify the Title Company that was associated with the sales transaction.

mainFields.name: TITLE COMPANY NAME
mainFields.definition: This is the Title Company associated with the sales transaction.

mainFields.name: RESIDENTIAL INDICATOR
mainFields.definition: Indicates whether the property is residential. Y = yes or NULL = no or unknown.

mainFields.name: SELLER NAME
mainFields.definition: The seller's name as it appears on the recorded sales transaction.

mainFields.name: FRONT FOOTAGE
mainFields.definition: The linear feet across the front of the lot - facing the street.

mainFields.name: DEPTH FOOTAGE
mainFields.definition: The linear feet between the front and back of the lot.

mainFields.name: TOTAL NUMBER OF ACRES
mainFields.definition: CoreLogic derived or county provided value that indicates the total acreage of the parcel.

mainFields.name: TOTAL LAND SQUARE FOOTAGE
mainFields.definition: Total land mass in square feet.

mainFields.name: EASEMENT TYPE CODE
mainFields.definition: County provided code describing easement(s) that may exist on the property. Note: An easement is a right granted to one party with regard to the land of another party. Most easements provide for access across one property to another. This can also be a green space or waterways between two properties or county or city property such as city gas lines running across a property. Example: 2 = Flood Control Easement. Easement value is delivered if available, otherwise easement code is delivered.

mainFields.name: YEAR BUILT
mainFields.definition: This is the construction year of the original building on the parcel as provided by the county. Not all counties maintain both Original and Effective Year Built. Null if not available from the source. Format: YYYY

mainFields.name: EFFECTIVE YEAR BUILT
mainFields.definition: Typically this field reflects the first year the building was assessed with its current components (e.g., a building is originally constructed in 1960 and a bedroom and bath was added to the building in 1974. In this example, Year Built would be 1960 and the Effective Year Built would be 1974). Certain counties only maintain one Year Built data element, and overlay Original Year Built with Effective Year Built if there was a structural change to the building that affected Assessed Value. In these counties, Year Built will be null and Effective Year Built will contain the single data element provided by the source - examples include Fresno and San Diego counties. Format: YYYY

mainFields.name: TOTAL NUMBER OF BEDROOMS - ALL BUILDINGS
mainFields.definition: CoreLogic calculated total bedrooms for all the buildings on the property.

mainFields.name: TOTAL NUMBER OF ROOMS - ALL BUILDINGS
mainFields.definition: Total number of rooms as supplied by the source.

mainFields.name: TOTAL NUMBER OF BATHROOMS - ALL BUILDINGS
mainFields.definition: Total number of rooms that are considered bathrooms across all buildings on the property.  For example, a half bathroom is considered one room.

mainFields.name: TOTAL NUMBER OF BATHROOMS
mainFields.definition: Total number of rooms that are Bathrooms (Primary Building) if this is the method of establishing bathroom property characterized by the source.  Source values are whole numbers, although field allows for up to 2 decimal places in data deliveries.

mainFields.name: TOTAL NUMBER OF FULL BATHS - ALL BUILDINGS
mainFields.definition: Total number of full bath rooms as supplied by source. If source does not break out full versus partial Baths -field will be null in this case.

mainFields.name: TOTAL NUMBER OF HALF BATHS - ALL BUILDINGS
mainFields.definition: Total number of half bath rooms (typically comprised of a sink & toilet) as supplied by source. If source does not break out full versus partial Baths – field will be null in this case.

mainFields.name: TOTAL NUMBER OF 1QTR BATHS - ALL BUILDINGS
mainFields.definition: Total number of quarter bath rooms (typically comprised only of a sink, as found in many laundry rooms) as supplied by source. If source does not break out full versus partial Baths – field will be null in this case.

mainFields.name: TOTAL NUMBER OF 3QTR BATHS - ALL BUILDINGS
mainFields.definition: Total number of three-quarter bath rooms (typically comprised of a sink, toilet & shower stall) as supplied by source.  If source does not break out full versus partial Baths – field will be null in this case.

mainFields.name: TOTAL NUMBER OF BATH FIXTURES
mainFields.definition: The total number of bathroom fixtures - Primary Building (typically a full bath would have 4 fixtures - 1 = sink, 1 = toilet, 1 = bathtub, 1 = shower head).

mainFields.name: TOTAL NUMBER OF BATH FIXTURES - ALL BUILDINGS
mainFields.definition: CoreLogic calculated total designated bath fixtures associated with all the bathrooms in all the buildings on the property. Examples: sink, toilet, shower stall, tub and faucets.

mainFields.name: AIR CONDITIONING TYPE CODE
mainFields.definition: The type of air conditioning method used to cool the building (e.g., Central, Wall Unit, Evaporative).

mainFields.name: BASEMENT FINISH TYPE CODE
mainFields.definition: The standardized code that identifies the basement's degree of completion.

mainFields.name: BASEMENT TYPE CODE
mainFields.definition: The standardized basement type.

mainFields.name: FIREPLACE INDICATOR
mainFields.definition: This field is populated with a "Y" if a fireplace is located within the building.

mainFields.name: TOTAL NUMBER OF FIREPLACES
mainFields.definition: This represents the number of fireplace openings located within all buildings on the property.

mainFields.name: FIREPLACE TYPE CODE
mainFields.definition: The type of fireplace. If more than one fireplace, this field reflects the first/main building.

mainFields.name: FLOOR TYPE CODE
mainFields.definition: The type of floor construction (e.g., Concrete, Plywood).

mainFields.name: HEATING TYPE CODE
mainFields.definition: Type or method of heating (e.g., Hot Water, Heat Pump, Baseboard, Radiant).

mainFields.name: STORIES TYPE CODE
mainFields.definition: Type / number of stories (e.g., Split Foyer, Tri Level, 2 Story).

mainFields.name: TOTAL NUMBER OF STORIES
mainFields.definition: Number of stories associated with the building.

mainFields.name: BUILDING TYPE CODE
mainFields.definition: The primary building type (e.g., Bowling Alley, Supermarket).

mainFields.name: BUILDING IMPROVEMENT TYPE CODE
mainFields.definition: The primary improvement type (e.g., Grain Silo, Hanger, Marina).

mainFields.name: BUILDING IMPROVEMENT CONDITION CODE
mainFields.definition: This represents the physical condition of the main improvement (e.g., Good, Fair, Under Construction).

mainFields.name: CONSTRUCTION TYPE CODE
mainFields.definition: The primary method of construction (e.g., Steel / Glass, Concrete Block, Log).

mainFields.name: EXTERIOR WALL TYPE CODE
mainFields.definition: The type and/or finish of the exterior walls (e.g., Vinyl Siding, Brick Veneer, Frame / Stone).

mainFields.name: FOUNDATION TYPE CODE
mainFields.definition: The type of foundation (e.g., Continuous Footing, Pier, Mud Sill).

mainFields.name: FRAME TYPE CODE
mainFields.definition: The type of wall framing used (e.g., Bar Joist, Reinforced Concrete, Flexicore).

mainFields.name: GARAGE TYPE CODE
mainFields.definition: Type of garage or carport present (e.g., Attached Finished, Enclosed Carport, Basement Garage).

mainFields.name: TOTAL NUMBER OF PARKING SPACES
mainFields.definition: This represents the total number of parking spaces or car capacity associated with the garage or parking type.

mainFields.name: PARKING TYPE CODE
mainFields.definition: Type of parking found on the parcel. This is typically commercial or communal in nature (e.g., Condos).

mainFields.name: POOL INDICATOR
mainFields.definition: This field is populated with a "Y" if a Pool is present on the parcel.

mainFields.name: POOL TYPE CODE
mainFields.definition: Type of pool, construction or pool amenities (e.g., Kidney, Gunite, Vinyl, Jacuzzi, Heated).

mainFields.name: BUILDING QUALITY CODE
mainFields.definition: Type of construction quality of building (e.g., excellent, economical).

mainFields.name: ROOF COVER TYPE CODE
mainFields.definition: Type of roof covering (e.g., Clay Tile, Aluminum, Shake).

mainFields.name: ROOF TYPE CODE
mainFields.definition: Type of roof (e.g., Gambrel, Gable, Flat, Mansard).

mainFields.name: BUILDING STYLE TYPE CODE
mainFields.definition: Type of building style (e.g., Colonial, Cape Code, Bungalow).

mainFields.name: TOTAL NUMBER OF UNITS - ALL BUILDINGS
mainFields.definition: Number of residential, apartment or business units.

mainFields.name: UNIVERSAL BUILDING SQUARE FEET
mainFields.definition: The Building Square Footage that reflects the most accurate available for use in assessments or comparables (e.g., Living, Adjusted, Gross).

mainFields.name: UNIVERSAL BUILDING SQUARE FEET SOURCE CODE
mainFields.definition: The codes appearing in this field indicates the source used to populate the UNIVERSAL BUILDING SQUARE FEET field. A=ADJUSTED, B=TOTAL, D or R=GROUND FLOOR, G=GROSS, L=LIVING, M=BASE/MAIN, H = HEATED AREA

mainFields.name: BUILDING AREA SQUARE FEET
mainFields.definition: The size of the building in square feet. This field is most commonly populated as an aggregate total when a county does not differentiate between living and non-living areas.

mainFields.name: TOTAL LIVING AREA SQUARE FEET - ALL BUILDINGS
mainFields.definition: This is the area of all buildings that are used for general living. This is typically the area of all buildings that is heated or air conditioned and generally does not include Garage, Porch or Unfinished Basement Square Footage values.

mainFields.name: GROUND FLOOR AREA SQUARE FEET
mainFields.definition: Square footage of the part of the building which is level with the ground (typically the front of the building). This is generally above the basement(s) and below the second floor.

mainFields.name: BUILDING GROSS AREA SQUARE FEET
mainFields.definition: This is the square footage for the entire building. Typically this represents all square feet under the roof.

mainFields.name: BUILDING ADJUSTED AREA SQUARE FEET
mainFields.definition: This is the square footage used by the county or local taxing / assessment authority to determine Improvement Value. This figure is typically 100% of the living area, plus lower percentage of non-living area.

mainFields.name: BASEMENT AREA SQUARE FEET
mainFields.definition: This is the total square footage associated with the Basement portion of a building. This would include both finished and unfinished areas.

mainFields.name: GARAGE OR PARKING SQUARE FEET
mainFields.definition: This is the total square footage of the primary garage or parking area.

mainFields.name: SECOND FLOOR AREA SQUARE FEET
mainFields.definition: Square footage of building level immediately above ground floor.

mainFields.name: FINISHED BASEMENT AREA SQUARE FEET
mainFields.definition: Square footage of below grade area improved for occupancy.

mainFields.name: UNFINISHED BASEMENT AREA SQUARE FEET
mainFields.definition: Square footage of below grade area not improved for occupancy.

mainFields.name: FUEL TYPE CODE
mainFields.definition: Type of fuel used for heating the parcel (e.g., Solar, Gas, Oil).

mainFields.name: ELECTRICITY/WIRING TYPE CODE
mainFields.definition: Type of electricity and/or type of wiring used for a parcel (e.g., Average Wiring, Underground Wired, Private Source).

mainFields.name: SEWER TYPE CODE
mainFields.definition: Type of sewer system on the parcel (e.g., Public, Septic, Commercial).

mainFields.name: UTILITIES TYPE CODE
mainFields.definition: The type of utilities used in a building (e.g., Electric, Oil, Private).

mainFields.name: WATER TYPE CODE
mainFields.definition: Type of water service on the parcel (e.g., Public, Well, Cistern).

mainFields.name: BUILDING FUEL TYPE CODE
mainFields.definition: Primary heating fuel used in the building as provided by the source.

mainFields.name: LAST ASSESSOR UPDATE DATE
mainFields.definition: Date which CoreLogic applied a full tax roll for a county (independent of Assessed Year and Tax Year).

mainFields.name: TAXROLL CERTIFICATION DATE
mainFields.definition: Assessor certified date of the full county refresh date for the county. Typically occurs first of month.

mainFields.name: TAXROLL EDITION NUMBER
mainFields.definition: CoreLogic internal tracking number assigned to the Current Taxroll Edition of assessor property data for a county or jurisdiction. For this data file, the current edition number is always greater than the previous historical Taxroll Edition Number of assessor property data for a county or jurisdiction. Example: If the previous Taxroll Edition Number for a county is 3, the Current Taxroll Edition Number is 4.

mainFields.name: BEGINNING TAX YEAR DATE
mainFields.definition: County provided start of the tax period year for the most recent tax bill processed. If the tax period is on a calendar year basis, the beginning and ending year date is the same.

mainFields.name: ENDING TAX YEAR DATE
mainFields.definition: County provided the end of the tax period year for the most recent tax bill processed. If the tax period is on a calendar year basis, the beginning and ending year date is the same.

mainFields.name: TOTAL SQUARE FOOTAGE OPEN AREAS
mainFields.definition: CoreLogic calculated total square footage allocated to all open areas for the property.

mainFields.name: TOTAL AREA SQUARE FOOTAGE - ALL BUILDINGS
mainFields.definition: CoreLogic calculated total square footage allocated to all square footage for all buildings on the property.

mainFields.name: TOTAL AREA SQUARE FOOTAGE OFFICE SPACE - ALL BUILDINGS
mainFields.definition: CoreLogic calculated total office area square footage in all the buildings on the property.

mainFields.name: TOTAL NUMBER OF ELEVATORS - ALL BUILDINGS
mainFields.definition: CoreLogic calculated total number of elevators for all the buildings on the property. This is mostly in use for commercial buildings.

mainFields.name: TOTAL NUMBER OF LOADING DOCKS - ALL BUILDINGS
mainFields.definition: CoreLogic calculated total of loading docks for all the buildings on the property. This is mostly in use for commercial buildings.

mainFields.name: TOTAL NUMBER OF RAIL SPURS - ALL BUILDINGS
mainFields.definition: CoreLogic calculated total of rail spurs for all the buildings on the property. This is mostly in use for commercial buildings.

mainFields.name: TOTAL NUMBER OF TRUCK DOORS - ALL BUILDINGS
mainFields.definition: CoreLogic calculated total number of truck doors for all the buildings on the property. This is mostly in use for commercial buildings.

mainFields.name: TOTAL NUMBER OF 1 BEDROOMS
mainFields.definition: CoreLogic calculated total number of one (1) bedroom units for all the buildings on the property. This is mostly in use for rental or multi-family buildings.

mainFields.name: TOTAL NUMBER OF 2 BEDROOMS
mainFields.definition: CoreLogic calculated total number of two (2) bedroom units for all the buildings on the property. This is mostly in use for rental or multi-family buildings.

mainFields.name: TOTAL NUMBER OF 3 BEDROOMS
mainFields.definition: CoreLogic calculated total number of three (3) bedroom units for all the buildings on the property. This is mostly in use for rental or multi-family buildings.

mainFields.name: TOTAL NUMBER OF EFFICIENCY UNITS
mainFields.definition: CoreLogic calculated total number of efficiency units for all the buildings on the property. This is mostly in use for rental or multi-family buildings.

mainFields.name: OWNER 1 IDENTIFIER
mainFields.definition: Unique identification number associated with the first Owner listed from the Assessor data, either an individual or business. For a business, this does NOT include name resolution or roll-up of subsidiaries, i.e. “CoreLogic LLC” and “CoreLogic NA” may receive two separate ID’s.

mainFields.name: OWNER 2 IDENTIFIER
mainFields.definition: Unique identification number associated with the second Owner listed from the Assessor data, either an individual or business. For a business, this does NOT include name resolution or roll-up of subsidiaries, i.e. “CoreLogic LLC” and “CoreLogic NA” may receive two separate ID’s.

mainFields.name: OWNER 3 IDENTIFIER
mainFields.definition: Unique identification number associated with the third Owner listed from the Assessor data, either an individual or business. For a business, this does NOT include name resolution or roll-up of subsidiaries, i.e. “CoreLogic LLC” and “CoreLogic NA” may receive two separate ID’s

mainFields.name: OWNER 4 IDENTIFIER
mainFields.definition: Unique identification number associated with the fourth Owner listed from the Assessor data, either an individual or business. For a business, this does NOT include name resolution or roll-up of subsidiaries, i.e. “CoreLogic LLC” and “CoreLogic NA” may receive two separate ID’s.

mainFields.name: LAST MARKET SALE DERIVED DATE
mainFields.definition: CoreLogic proprietary sale date derived from the original public record filing, representing the date that the Deed was prepared in advance of being notarized and prior to being recorded.  Format: YYYYMMDD.

mainFields.name: LAST MARKET SALE AMOUNT
mainFields.definition: Dollar amount of the most recent sale of the property.

mainFields.name: LAST MARKET SALE MULTI OR SPLIT PARCEL CODE
mainFields.definition: Indicates either that the transaction involves multiple parcels, or the split of an existing parcel.

mainFields.name: MODEL NAME - RM
mainFields.definition: Total Home Value Model Name.

mainFields.name: MODEL VERSION - RM
mainFields.definition: Total Home Value Model Version Number. Example 1.0.1

mainFields.name: VALUE AS OF DATE - RM
mainFields.definition: The date the model estimated the value. Format: YYYYMMDD

mainFields.name: ESTIMATED VALUE - RM
mainFields.definition: Estimated market value of the subject property. Example: 720000

mainFields.name: ESTIMATED VALUE HIGH - RM
mainFields.definition: The highest likely property value estimate in the Estimated Value Range. Example: 740000

mainFields.name: ESTIMATED VALUE LOW - RM
mainFields.definition: The lowest likely property value estimate in the Estimated Value Range. Example: 710000

mainFields.name: CONFIDENCE SCORE - RM
mainFields.definition: The confidence score is a measure of the extent to which sales data, property information, and comparable sales support the property valuation analysis process. Higher numbers means higher confidence. Range: 0-100

mainFields.name: FORECAST STANDARD DEVIATION - RM
mainFields.definition: Represent 68% statistic certainty that the estimated property value is within +- FSD score. Lower numbers means higher confidence. Range: 0-50

mainFields.name: RESULT CODE - RM
mainFields.definition: Numeric representation of the result description. Range: 1-3

mainFields.name: RESULT DESCRIPTION - RM
mainFields.definition: The result description that will identify if the evaluation is successful or unsuccessful. If the unsuccessful, it will include reason details.

mainFields.name: PURCHASE RECORDING DATE
mainFields.definition: The date the transaction was recorded at the county. Format: YYYYMMDD.

mainFields.name: PURCHASE AMOUNT
mainFields.definition: Dollar amount of the most recent purchase of the property.

mainFields.name: TOTAL NUMBER OF OPEN MORTGAGE LIENS
mainFields.definition: Total number of open mortgage liens against the property.

mainFields.name: TOTAL AMOUNT OF OPEN MORTGAGE LIENS
mainFields.definition: Sum total of origination amounts of open mortgage liens against the property.

mainFields.name: PURCHASE COMBINED LTV (LOAN TO VALUE)
mainFields.definition: Ratio of purchase mortgages against purchase amount.

mainFields.name: ESTIMATED EQUITY
mainFields.definition: Difference between current AVM Value and the sum of all open, original loan amounts, for all open liens.

mainFields.name: ESTIMATED COMBINED LTV (LOAN TO VALUE)
mainFields.definition: Ratio of the sum amount of all open liens at origination divided into the current AVM value.

mainFields.name: FIRST POSITION COMPOSITE TRANSACTION ID
mainFields.definition: Unique transaction key comprised of FIPS Code, Transaction Batch Date, Transaction Sequence Number, and Mortgage Sequence Number.

mainFields.name: FIRST POSITION MORTGAGE LTV (LOAN TO VALUE)
mainFields.definition: Ratio of origination loan amount divided into current AVM value.

mainFields.name: FIRST POSITION MULTI OR SPLIT PARCEL CODE
mainFields.definition: Indicates either that the transaction involves multiple parcels, or the split of an existing parcel.

mainFields.name: FIRST POSITION MORTGAGE TYPE CODE
mainFields.definition: CoreLogic standardized mortgage classification for principal mortgages ('P'urchase, 'R'efinance) or subordinate mortgages ('J'unior).

mainFields.name: FIRST POSITION MORTGAGE PURPOSE CODE
mainFields.definition: CoreLogic standardized value indicating the reason for the principal or subordinate mortgage.

mainFields.name: FIRST POSITION MORTGAGE DATE
mainFields.definition: Borrower's signature date on mortgage/deed of trust. This represents the date the borrower’s obligation to the lender begins, i.e. loan open date. This date is the same or prior to the recording date. If the day and/or month is missing, CoreLogic populates these values with 00. Format: YYYYMMDD.

mainFields.name: FIRST POSITION MORTGAGE RECORDING DATE
mainFields.definition: The date the mortgage transaction was recorded at the county. Format: YYYYMMDD.

mainFields.name: FIRST POSITION MORTGAGE RECORDED DOCUMENT YEAR
mainFields.definition: The year the mortgage transaction was recorded at the county. Format: YYYY.

mainFields.name: FIRST POSITION MORTGAGE RECORDED DOCUMENT NUMBER
mainFields.definition: The document number used by some counties to record mortgage transactions.

mainFields.name: FIRST POSITION MORTGAGE RECORDED DOCUMENT BOOK NUMBER
mainFields.definition: The Book number used by some counties to catalog their mortgage recordings. (e.g., 001234)

mainFields.name: FIRST POSITION MORTGAGE RECORDED DOCUMENT PAGE NUMBER
mainFields.definition: The Page number used by some counties to catalog their mortgage recordings. (e.g., 001234)

mainFields.name: FIRST POSITION MORTGAGE AMOUNT
mainFields.definition: The amount of the mortgage at the time of the transaction.

mainFields.name: FIRST POSITION MORTGAGE LOAN TYPE CODE
mainFields.definition: CoreLogic standardized value indicating the type of loan secured. (e.g., Conventional, FHA, VA).

mainFields.name: ESTIMATED RENTAL VALUE
mainFields.definition: Estimated rental value of the property.

mainFields.name: ESTIMATED RENTAL VALUE HIGH
mainFields.definition: Prediction Interval – Upper Limit. Calculation is: Estimated rental value + (Forecast Standard Deviation * Estimated rental value of the property). Example: 2000 + (0.1 * 2000) = 2200

mainFields.name: ESTIMATED RENTAL VALUE LOW
mainFields.definition: Prediction Interval – Lower Limit. Calculation is: Estimated rental value – (Forecast Standard Deviation * Estimated rental value of the property). Example: 2000 - (0.1 * 2000) = 1800

mainFields.name: ESTIMATED RENTAL FORECAST STANDARD DEVIATION SCORE
mainFields.definition: Estimated Rental Forecast Standard Deviation - (Actual Rental value will fall within +/- one FSD of the estimated rental value 68 percent of the time.)

mainFields.name: CAP RATE
mainFields.definition: Capitalization rate is the ratio between the net operating income (NOI) (e.g. expected annual income produced by the property) divided by its capital cost or value (e.g. the original price paid to buy the asset) or alternatively its current market value. Used by investors to estimate the return on an investment.

mainFields.name: RECORD ACTION INDICATOR
mainFields.definition: A CoreLogic system generated indicator used to advise customers how to process records contained in delta files.  Values are: A = ADD, Customer will do an UPSERT, U = UPDATE, Customer will do an UPSERT, D = DELETE, Customer will do a DELETE, BLANK = No Action Required.  BLANK is used for Initial Delivery Files or Refresh Files.

UNKNOWN - Full or Partial sale distinction is unclear on doc or unchecked (CA only).
